differentiators.ours: {{Product}} removes the manual work and delays that the current process absorbs every week, and makes the cost of the problem visible.
differentiators.theirs: Doing nothing feels free, but the cost shows up as hours on workarounds, slow decisions, errors, and missed opportunities.
talkingPoints: Quantify the weekly hours spent on workarounds
Put a number on the risk and errors of the current process
Every quarter of delay compounds the cost
differentiators.demo: Recreate one painful workflow from discovery and time it live, before and after.

differentiators.feature: Growing past spreadsheets and manual processes
differentiators.ours: Built to scale with the business: more users, more data, more volume without adding headcount.
differentiators.theirs: Spreadsheets and manual handoffs work until they don't. They break silently as the team and volume grow.
talkingPoints: What works for ten people rarely works for a hundred
Single source of truth instead of copies and versions
Audit trail and governance come built in
differentiators.demo: Show the same task at 10x volume with no extra effort.

differentiators.ours: Process and knowledge live in {{product}}, not in one person's head or one fragile spreadsheet.
differentiators.theirs: The current process often depends on a few people who know how it works. When they are out or leave, it stops.
talkingPoints: Ask who would be missed most if they left tomorrow
Documented, repeatable workflows
Access controls instead of shared files
differentiators.demo: Hand the workflow to a new user and have them complete it without training.

differentiators.feature: Build cost versus total cost of ownership
differentiators.ours: A predictable subscription that includes hosting, security, upgrades, and support.
differentiators.theirs: The first version is the cheap part. Maintenance, on-call, security patches, and new requests typically cost several times the initial build.
talkingPoints: Maintenance typically dwarfs the initial build
Hidden costs: on-call, security, compliance, documentation
Predictable spend versus open-ended engineering time
differentiators.demo: Walk through the admin, security, and upgrade features they would otherwise have to build.

differentiators.ours: Go live on a first use case in weeks with a proven rollout playbook.
differentiators.theirs: Internal builds compete with the product roadmap for engineers and routinely slip by quarters.
talkingPoints: Value starts in weeks, not after a build cycle
No competition for scarce engineering time
Benefit from years of customer-driven product development
differentiators.demo: Configure a working version of their use case live during the call.

differentiators.ours: Frees engineering to focus on the product and experiences that set the business apart.
differentiators.theirs: Every engineer maintaining internal tooling is one not working on the core product.
talkingPoints: Opportunity cost of engineering time
Buy commodity, build differentiation
Extensible APIs when they do need something custom
differentiators.demo: Show the APIs and extension points that cover custom needs without a full build.

differentiators.feature: Built for the people who use it every day
differentiators.ours: A modern, intuitive experience that business users adopt without weeks of training.
differentiators.theirs: Legacy platforms were designed for specialists. Business users depend on a few power users or avoid the tool entirely.
talkingPoints: Adoption is the real measure of ROI
Less training, fewer tickets to the admin team
Self-service for business users
differentiators.demo: Have a business stakeholder complete a task themselves during the demo.

differentiators.ours: Frequent releases with capabilities delivered to every customer automatically.
differentiators.theirs: Large incumbents often ship slowly, gate new features behind upgrades or add-on SKUs, and prioritise their largest accounts.
talkingPoints: Recent release highlights and roadmap
No painful upgrade projects
Customer input shapes the roadmap
differentiators.demo: Show two capabilities released in the last quarter.

differentiators.ours: Clear pricing that scales with value, without surprise add-ons.
differentiators.theirs: Complex licensing, bundles, and add-ons make the real cost hard to predict and harder to reduce.
talkingPoints: Compare the full cost, including add-ons and services
Pricing that grows with usage and value
Room to start small and expand
differentiators.demo: Walk through a pricing scenario that matches their rollout plan.

differentiators.feature: Works with your stack, not just ours
differentiators.ours: Open integrations and APIs that work with the tools they already have.
differentiators.theirs: Incumbent suites often work best only inside their own ecosystem, creating lock-in.
talkingPoints: Keep the tools you like; connect them
Avoid single-vendor lock-in
Standard APIs and export options
differentiators.demo: Connect {{product}} to one of their existing systems live.

differentiators.feature: One platform instead of another silo
differentiators.ours: Covers the whole workflow, so data and process stay connected as needs grow.
differentiators.theirs: A point tool solves today's narrow problem and adds one more silo, login, and integration to maintain.
talkingPoints: Fewer tools, fewer integrations, fewer contracts
Room to grow into adjacent use cases
One place for security and governance
differentiators.demo: Show how a second use case builds on the first without new tooling.

differentiators.ours: Enterprise-grade security, access controls, and support from day one.
differentiators.theirs: Smaller point tools may lack certifications, admin controls, or support needed as usage grows.
talkingPoints: Certifications and security documentation ready
Granular roles and permissions
Support and SLAs that match the business
differentiators.demo: Show admin controls, audit logs, and permissions.
